## Workload

Tomas Brennan completed 650 reads during 450 rostered hours. This represents an average of 1.4 reads per hour. The workload was recorded against the agreed session pattern, which remained in place for the period under review.

## Quality

A sample of 57 reads was checked as part of the quality review. Agreement between the grading and review outcomes was 57.9 per cent. The results were considered alongside the workload information to provide an overall view of grading performance.

The current session pattern was retained following consideration of the workload and quality findings. The review was completed by Priya Anand.
